specification.title: Osnap Surface And Polysurface
specification.goal: surface nearest point and eligible face snapping
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tạo picking engine thứ hai; GUI toggle Matrix thuộc 03.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Osnap Surface And Polysurface” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Osnap Surface And Polysurface”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

runtime_implementation.surface_snap_trim_1024_2026_11_13: Tested reopened plane and cylinder trims through 1024 edges snap to material rather than holes; simulated Line/Undo/Redo passed. Arbitrary trim and actual desktop unverified. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-13-large-trim-support.md#surface-snap-on-1024-edge-trim-material
runtime_implementation.curved_fallback_occlusion_2026_11_13: Tested reopened affine cylinder allows Surface Snap to a rear plane through an excluded front region or hole, then Line and Undo/Redo, in simulated Wireframe/Shaded; front material and near-hole-edge cases block. Numerical/geometry scope, desktop and native peak remain open. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-13-fallback-source-selection.md#viewport-line-through-the-curved-hole

planar_fallback_grazing_ray_guard_2026_1.scope: A nearly parallel ray no longer clears fallback occlusion in the tested identity and scale/shear fixtures; ordinary, near-boundary and simulated pressure checks and 26 osnap UI tests pass.
planar_fallback_grazing_ray_guard_2026_1.remaining: Global floating-point accuracy, other geometry, desktop, latency and native peak remain open.

planar_fallback_shaded_snap_2026_11_13.scope: A verified affine plane can clear fallback occlusion when its source ray is well outside its outer UV bound; near/inside and memory-denied cases remain blocked. Egui document/Redo, identity and scale/shear proof, other occluder, 26 osnap UI, seven broad-phase and scene suite passed.
planar_fallback_shaded_snap_2026_11_13.remaining: Curved and periodic fallback, global numerical proof, desktop, latency and native peak remain open.

surface_snap_behind_fallback_2026_11_12.scope: Unverified fallback is skipped as a snap candidate; egui fixture reaches a valid rear surface in Wireframe, retains conservative Shaded occlusion and preserves document and Redo. osnap_ui 26, broad-phase 7 and full scene suite passed.
surface_snap_behind_fallback_2026_11_12.remaining: Source-aware Shaded occlusion, broader topology and desktop remain open.

runtime_implementation.scope: The BRep display tessellation is ray-hit nearest-first; the hit point and triangle normal form the surface candidate, so only trimmed display faces can snap.
remaining: Manual M02-UI review pending; no human sign-off is claimed.

standalone_verification_2026_10_22.acceptance: A ray through a planar box face returns an on-face point and the face normal; a ray outside the trimmed face produces no surface snap.

trim_aware_surface_snap_2026_11_12.scope: Source ray UV hits are ordered and classified against validated trim with source evaluation, boundary ambiguity refusal and managed scratch admission. Reopened cylinder skips front hole and snaps to rear; simulated pressure and worker retry pass. UI 22, BRep 1, Surface Snap lib 7, kernel surface 14 and core UV 1 tests pass; no-default check, debug build and source audit pass.
trim_aware_surface_snap_2026_11_12.limitations: Boundary floating-point screen is not an interval proof, native memory peak not bounded, other seam, placement, topology, desktop and physical RAM remain unverified. Fallback display still shows full source but snap is refused. Plan A open; B deferred.

trim_closed_seam_snap_2026_11_12.scope: Certified full-seam trimmed cylinder snaps at the exact seam after save/reopen for identity and translation; true outer boundary, near-but-not-exact seam and holes close to seam are not certified by the helper. Surface Snap lib 8, UI 23, BRep snap 1 passed; debug build and source audit passed.
trim_closed_seam_snap_2026_11_12.limitations: Other periodic seam topologies, near-degenerate cases, general placement, physical desktop and native peak remain unverified. Plan A open; B deferred.

parallel_view_snap_2026_11_12.limitations: Headless Surface and Endpoint fixtures only; other commands, cameras and desktop unverified.

circular_hole_product_path_2026_11_13.scope: Authored drilled block refines one material point and refuses a candidate with a manipulated hole cursor.
circular_hole_product_path_2026_11_13.remaining: Actual desktop, arbitrary holes and whole-display verification remain open.
